title: WhatsApp AI Agent kaise kaam karta hai?
hooks: Raat do baje WhatsApp par order bheja, aur do second mein confirm!
WhatsApp par message bhejte hi do second mein order confirm kaise hua?
Bina kisi staff ke WhatsApp par do second mein payment aur order confirm!
hook_why: Opens immediately with a late-night relatable scenario and instant payoff, cutting all fluff.
metaphor: Digital Nervous System — glowing signal packets moving through Meta Cloud, Webhook doorbell, AI brain, and API tools on a dark canvas
mechanism: User message hits Meta cloud server
Webhook acts like a doorbell forwarding event payload to the business server
AI model reads intent with conversation history context
AI chooses backend inventory and payment tools automatically
Stock is verified and UPI payment link is generated inside WhatsApp
Payment gateway sends confirmation callback to agent
Agent sends response back via Meta Send API delivering confirmation to user

caption:
WhatsApp par late night order 2 second mein kaise confirm hota hai? 🤖🍕

Peeche Meta Cloud, Webhooks, LLM reasoning, Razorpay payment aur callback ka poora system kaam karta hai bina kisi insaan ke.

Apne roz ke kaamo mein se konsa kaam AI agent ko dena chahte ho? Comment mein batao! 👇

claims.claim: Razorpay Agent Studio handles approximately 5 lakh monthly agent runs

claims.claim: WhatsApp AI agents receive events via Meta Webhook, query backend inventory, generate UPI links, receive payment callbacks, and return order confirmations via Meta Send API
claims.basis: Meta for Developers WhatsApp Business Platform API & Webisoft Technical Guide on Goal-based Agent Tool Execution

steps_learned: User WhatsApp par message bhejta hai jo Meta cloud server par receive hota hai

Payment integration ke through UPI link banta hai aur payment confirm hone par callback aata hai
API ke through Meta confirmation receipt wapas bhejta hai
